pulse-2001.title: Pulse
pulse-2001.text: Exceptional technical ability to invoke horror out of simple and calculated devices. The cuts, story boarding, scene composition, colour grading, the palette, movement of both the actors and the camera, depiction of ghosts - in their form, motion and voice, how they fit into their environment, their interactions with people - every little thing done so brilliantly. It gives the impression that the makers have studied which devices invoke fear in people, and has mastered and simplified them for us to see and to show what can be possible with so little at hand. aattam.title: Aattam
aattam.text: I am full and I rarely get that feeling after a movie. Rich, interesting and nuanced. People are connected to events which connect themselves to people. A cobweb. Most stable social relations are stable solely because they're too blind to see the intricacies of this cobweb. We are blissfully ignorant, but we must not be, and I try my best not to be. Clarity is a savior, and it saves us from lots of headache, yet it's so easily forgotten amid turbulent emotions or complacency. All that nuance made the characters on screen unmistakably human.
